effects.actual_behavior: Native Bucketable pickup calls actor saveToBucketTag then replaces hand and discards actor. No loader patch for CustomData/Bucketable/MobBucketItem. Custom extra writes do not establish persisted slimed/scale/variant/babyAge/TriopsTag; a preexisting BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA payload can still be loaded by native actor load callback. Original entity NBT contracts remain separate, no new state/owner introduced.

effects.actual_behavior: Native parent hurt runs first; only accepted hurt AND causing DamageSource.getEntity()!=null resets own glideIn and nearby FlyingFish within AABB(15,7.5,15) to0. Direct projectile alone is not used as causing actor. Initial glideIn=50+rand75; stop=150+rand75, clear target/gliding. Approach surface at native1.2F; first launch Y=.4F+rand*.2F, horizontal facing*.1F. Actual delta.add uses (target.x,y,target.y), not target.z as third coordinate. Already gliding and in water stops goal; descending out of water multiplies Y by.5. Land flop probability.05, Y+.5, X/Z random +/- .2. No damage/status payload and no team/owner reassignment. Empty current checkFallDamage suppresses fall check; obsolete two-argument causeFallDamage is not current native three-argument override. Dry-air damage2 at -20/reset0, recovery1000. Water self-travel drag(.9,.6F,.9), targetless Y-.005. Native isFlying always true, not the gliding flag. NBT bucket/variant only; gliding/timer transient.

effects.display_name: Lobster Native Retaliation and Timed Second Strike
effects.actual_behavior: Registered HP5/armor2/attack2/speed.15F. HurtByTarget goal supplies retaliation target; no melee goal but direct tick attack is active. doHurtTarget sets ATTACK_TICK5 BEFORE returning original parent native attack result (attribute2 plus original defenses/enchantments). Tick attacks target when distance<=1 and attackCooldown==0; cooldown20 even if initial hurt fails. Separately positive ATTACK_TICK==2 and target distance<1.3 issues mobAttack(this) hurt2F and POPs its result; no initial hurt-success check. Keep the two original requests separately, no fabricated duplicate event or knockback. Attack animation counter decrements, cooldown decrements ifpositive; only native target is used, no added ally test. Water travel jumping: delta*1.4 +Y.72; otherwise*.4 +Y-.08. baseTick restores previous air after parent when in water; outside inherited WaterAnimal admission remains. Native bucket/name persistence and FromBucket/Variant NBT.

effects.display_name: Triops Native Feeding Heal and Admission
effects.actual_behavior: Dropped-item goal calls onGetItem then shrinks1 independently of healing acceptance. canTargetItem accepts TRIOPS_BREEDABLES or MOSQUITO_LARVA and !fedCarrot. onGetItem additionally requires FOOD component and nonnull getFoodProperties before heal5; server with breedCooldown==0/!fedCarrot sets fedCarrot and broadcasts67. Player mobInteract first calls parent; if result not consuming and accepted target item/!fed, shrinks1 unless creative and heals5. Only tagged breedable then sets fedCarrot; otherwise Bucketable native pickup. Native actor self-heal, no attack target/damage/status payload. Dry-out requested random1/0 at air -20/reset0; recovery2000. Swim drag(.9,.8,.9)/targetless Y-.005. fedCarrot/baby/bucket custom persistence and exact NBT; positive breedCooldown decrements, negative baby age is tested but this tick does not increment it. Ordinary mate/egg placement is excluded acquisition/reproduction, not offensive summon. Shared target goal uses native radius9 centered offset+.5, item age>10 at Triops registration, passenger/controlled-vehicle/mainhand gates, canTargetItem selector, squared distance < getMaxDistToItem default2; native target item is consumed1 after onGetItem even if food/heal branch did not run. No owner is assigned by that consumption.
